label: Germinal products identification, certification and traceability
description: Germinal Products covers identification, certification, storage, movement tracking, and traceability of semen, ova, embryos, and reproductive materials used in breeding and trade. Supports biosecurity, veterinary standards, genetic quality, and disease prevention.
